audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly credits his sustain to a 'Q pool' — Gragas has no pool. It also names none of his abilities.
audit.why: Riot's kit: Happy Hour (P) heals him periodically on skill use, Barrel Roll (Q) is the cask, Drunken Rage (W) is the drink that grants damage reduction and an empowered auto, Body Slam (E) is the charge-and-stun, Explosive Cask (R) is the knockback. The heal is the passive, not the Q.
audit.corrected: Sustain re-attributed to Happy Hour and every ability named in the early text, the spike and the foe wants.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere, so the 'bait his R before you commit' advice has no timer attached.
audit.why: Explosive Cask is 100/85/70, Body Slam 14s at rank 1, Barrel Roll 10s at rank 1, Drunken Rage 5s — the two displacements are the only long cooldowns in his kit.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into the cooldown breakdown and Key Ability Interactions.

audit.whatIsWrong: Body Slam is called a reposition and Drunken Rage is described only as 'W damage reduction'; the stun on Body Slam and the empowered auto on Drunken Rage are never stated.
audit.why: Body Slam stuns everything it collides with; Drunken Rage banks damage reduction and makes his next basic attack deal magic damage in an area.
audit.corrected: Both effects written into the foe wants and the level-2 why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Happy Hour's healing is never named, so no Grievous Wounds timing is given.
audit.why: Happy Hour heals on every ability cast, which is what wins him the extended trades the page tells you to avoid.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal timing added to the third Don't.

edits.before: His Q pool sustain and body-slam E let him trade and reset health while you have no trade pattern yet — just hold Granite Shield and farm at Q range.
edits.after: Happy Hour heals him off every cast and Body Slam (E) stuns and resets the trade while you have no pattern — hold Granite Shield, farm at Q range.

edits.before: Sustain through your poke with Q pool and reset every trade with body-slam E
edits.after: Heal off Happy Hour (P) every cast and reset trades with Body Slam (E)

edits.before: Land E knockup into Q in melee and use W damage reduction to win the brawl
edits.after: Stun you with Body Slam into Barrel Roll and drink Drunken Rage to brawl

edits.before: Save R knockback to interrupt your R dash mid-flight or to disengage your all-in
edits.after: Hold Explosive Cask (R) to knock you out of your R dash or disengage the all-in

edits.before: Gragas owns the opening because you have no trade pattern before your W and E come online — your Q Seismic Shard only pokes and slows, it does not win a brawl. He has Q pool sustain to heal any chip you land and a body-slam E to reset distance, so do not try to fight him at Levels 1-3. Hold Granite Shield by disengaging between last-hits, farm at the tip of Q, and respect that his E-flash can catch you out of position for a gank.
edits.after: Gragas owns the opening because you have no trade pattern before your W and E come online — Seismic Shard only pokes and slows, it does not win a brawl. Happy Hour heals him for every ability he casts, and Body Slam (E, 14s) stuns and resets the distance, so do not fight him at Levels 1-3. Hold Granite Shield by disengaging between last-hits, farm at the tip of Q, and respect that a Body Slam flash catches you for a gank.

edits.before: His body-slam E and Q sustain give him a trade-and-reset pattern you simply do not have until W and E unlock — he owns this window.
edits.after: Body Slam (E) stuns and resets while Happy Hour heals every cast — a trade pattern you do not have until W and E unlock, so he owns this window.

edits.before: - Gragas Body Slam: matchup-defining — His engage. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Body Slam (E): 14s at rank 1 — his engage and his exit, so step up once it is spent. - Explosive Cask (R): 100/85/70, held to knock you out of your own R. - Barrel Roll (Q): 10s. - Your ultimate: 130s.

edits.before: Track Gragas's Body Slam: His engage. Dodge it. When it is down — R-W-E him.
edits.after: Explosive Cask (R, 100s) knocks you out of your own R dash — bait it first.

edits.before: Trading with your passive shield down — that shield IS your trade margin; without it you are paying full price.
edits.after: Happy Hour heals him on every cast — Grievous Wounds goes on before the extended trade, not once he is already topped up.

notes: 'Q pool' appears nowhere in Riot's Gragas kit — his heal is Happy Hour (P). Corrected in the early text, the level-2 why and the spike; the same phrase may survive in other Malphite matchup text outside this slice. Malphite's kit derives a 'grounding' flag on Seismic Shard and Ground Slam that Riot's descriptions do not support; no grounding claim written.
